article.title: Chinese Hackers Use AI-Powered ARTEX to Target Over 200 Organizations Worldwide
article.summary: Chinese state-sponsored threat actors have been observed using a Go-based artificial intelligence (AI)-powered penetration testing framework called ARTEX in attacks aimed at high-value targets simultaneously. article.title: Fashion retailer Resolve says hackers stole payment card information
article.summary: The company, billing itself as “the next-generation fashion retailer for Millennial and Generation Z consumers,” said a recent hack exposed customer payment card numbers.

items.relevance_reason: Nhà bán lẻ thời trang Resolve đã xác nhận sự cố đánh cắp thông tin thẻ thanh toán của khách hàng sau một vụ tấn công mạng gần đây.

article.title: DOJ raises privacy concerns over potential sale of Character.AI chats
article.summary: The DOJ’s Executive Office for U.S. Trustees said a consumer privacy ombudsman is needed to advise the court on how to regulate what data from Character.AI can be sold and under what terms.
